menu.name: Seafood Fajita
menu.description: Grilled shrimp, scallops, and tilapia fillet cooked with tomatoes, bell peppers and onions. Served with rice, beans, guacamole, pico de gallo, lettuce and sour cream.

menu.name: Molcajete for Two
menu.description: Steak, Chicken, Shrimp, Chorizo cooked with onions, & bell peppers. Topped with Tomatoes, guacamole, sour cream, pico de gallo and lettuce, jalapeño, cilantro & lime. Served with charro beans and white rice.

menu.name: Rib-Eye y Camaron a la Plancha
menu.description: Rib-Eye & Shrimp with grilled mixed veggies on a bed of grilled onions.

menu.name: Seafood Soup
menu.description: Fish, Shrimp, Mussels, Crab Legs and vegetables cooked in a chile de arbol broth.

menu.name: Carne Asada
menu.description: Thin Steak cooked with onions, & bell peppers. Topped with Tomatoes, jalapeño, & lime. Served with rice, beans, guacamole, sour cream, pico de gallo and lettuce.

menu.name: Seafood Molcajete (for 2)
menu.description: Whole head on shrimp, scallops, mussels, whole fried tilapia in a special sauce. Garnished with pineapple, lime/lemon, and cucumber. Served with white rice, charro beans, tortillas, and guacamole salad.

menu.name: Pollo Blanco
menu.description: Grilled Chicken breast on a bed of grilled onions, bell peppers, tomatoes, and mushrooms topped with poblano sauce. Served with a side of white rice.

menu.name: Carnitas
menu.description: Shredded pork pieces marinated in a special sauce cooked with grilled onions. Served with pico de gallo, rice, beans, and tortillas.

menu.name: Alambres Cozumel
menu.description: Grilled chicken, steak, bacon, mushrooms, bell peppers, onions and tomatoes. Topped with mozzarella cheese. Served with rice, beans, lettuce, pico de gallo, guacamole, sour cream and tortillas.
